Run the command again.","command.dragonminez.restore.error":"§e[DMZ-Restore]§r §cA critic error occurred while deleting files: %s","dmz.saga.saiyan_saga":"Saiyan Saga","dmz.quest.defeat.obj":"Defeat %s","dmz.quest.obtain.obj":"Obtain %s","dmz.quest.talk_to.obj":"Talk to %s","dmz.quest.go_to.obj":"Go to %s","dmz.quest.interact.obj":"Interact with %s","dmz.quest.summon_dragon.obj":"Summon %s","dmz.quest.skill.obj":"Reach %s level %s","dmz.quest.saiyan1.name":"Defeat Raditz","dmz.quest.saiyan1.desc":"Raditz has come for Gohan in the plains. Defeat the invader and survive the opening strike of the Saiyan threat.","dmz.quest.saiyan2.name":"Wilderness Training","dmz.quest.saiyan2.desc":"Gohan's survival training begins in the wild. Hunt a dinosaur and prove you can endure the months before the Saiyans arrive.","dmz.quest.saiyan3.name":"Kill the Saibamen","dmz.quest.saiyan3.desc":"The Saiyan invasion begins with planted monsters. Wipe out the Saibamen before the real warriors take the field.","dmz.quest.saiyan4.name":"Hold Against Nappa","dmz.quest.saiyan4.desc":"Nappa is tearing through the battlefield. Hold the line and bring him down.","dmz.quest.saiyan5.name":"Face Vegeta","dmz.quest.saiyan5.desc":"With Nappa gone, the Saiyan prince steps in. Challenge Vegeta on the rocky battlefield.","dmz.quest.saiyan6.name":"Defeat Oozaru Vegeta","dmz.quest.saiyan6.desc":"Vegeta has transformed into a Great Ape. Finish the fight before the giant crushes Earth.","dmz.quest.saiyan7.name":"Prepare for Namek","dmz.quest.saiyan7.desc":"The next hope is on Namek. Speak with Bulma once the repaired ship is ready.","dmz.quest.saiyan8.name":"Head to Namek","dmz.quest.saiyan8.desc":"Leave Earth behind and travel to Namek before Frieza's forces claim the Dragon Balls.","dmz.saga.frieza_saga":"Frieza Saga","dmz.quest.frieza1.name":"Landing on Namek","dmz.quest.frieza1.desc":"You've reached Namek, but Frieza's patrols already control the Ajissa Plains. Secure a foothold before the real battles begin.","dmz.quest.frieza2.name":"Cui's Pursuit","dmz.quest.frieza2.desc":"Cui has tracked the resistance to Namek. Drop him before he can report back to Frieza.","dmz.quest.frieza3.name":"Defend the Namekians","dmz.quest.frieza3.desc":"Frieza's army is raiding Namekian settlements across the Ajissa Plains. Hold the line and protect the survivors.","dmz.quest.frieza4.name":"The Cruel Dodoria","dmz.quest.frieza4.desc":"Dodoria is sweeping the Ajissa Plains and leaving nothing behind. Hunt him down and end the massacre.","dmz.quest.frieza5.name":"Zarbon's True Form","dmz.quest.frieza5.desc":"Zarbon's elegance hides a far uglier power. Survive his transformation and finish the fight.","dmz.quest.frieza6.name":"The Saiyan Prince","dmz.quest.frieza6.desc":"Vegeta is carving his own path across Namek in search of power. Confront the prince before he gets ahead of everyone else.","dmz.quest.frieza7.name":"Ginyu Force: Guldo","dmz.quest.frieza7.desc":"The Ginyu Force has landed. Start by crushing Guldo before the squad overwhelms the battlefield.","dmz.quest.frieza8.name":"Recoome's Rampage","dmz.quest.frieza8.desc":"Recoome is all power and no restraint. Stop him before the entire front collapses.","dmz.quest.frieza9.name":"Burter and Jeice","dmz.quest.frieza9.desc":"Burter and Jeice are fighting as a pair. Break the duo before Captain Ginyu joins the battle himself.","dmz.quest.frieza10.name":"Captain Ginyu","dmz.quest.frieza10.desc":"Captain Ginyu has entered the fight. Take down the leader of the Ginyu Force before his tricks turn the battle upside down.","dmz.quest.frieza11.name":"Body Change Chaos","dmz.quest.frieza11.desc":"Ginyu has stolen Goku's body and turned the battlefield into chaos. End the confusion before Frieza arrives.","dmz.quest.frieza12.name":"Frieza, First Form","dmz.quest.frieza12.desc":"The tyrant himself has finally entered the battle. Stand against Frieza's first form and survive the opening clash.","dmz.quest.frieza13.name":"Frieza's Rising Horror","dmz.quest.frieza13.desc":"Frieza refuses to stay in one shape. Survive his second and third forms before he reaches his true body.","dmz.quest.frieza14.name":"Final Form Frieza","dmz.quest.frieza14.desc":"Frieza's final form is deceptively calm and infinitely more dangerous. Fight through the terror and force him back.","dmz.quest.frieza15.name":"100% Full Power","dmz.quest.frieza15.desc":"Frieza is done holding back. Face his full power and end the fight before Namek dies with him.","dmz.quest.frieza16.name":"Escape the Collapsing World","dmz.quest.frieza16.desc":"Namek is collapsing around you. Get out before the planet takes everyone down with it.","dmz.saga.android_saga":"Android Saga","dmz.quest.android1.name":"Mecha Frieza","dmz.quest.android1.desc":"Frieza has returned to Earth rebuilt as a machine. Stop him before Earth repeats Namek's fate.","dmz.quest.android2.name":"King Cold","dmz.quest.android2.desc":"King Cold has stepped onto the battlefield himself. Bring down the emperor before his rule reaches Earth.","dmz.quest.android3.name":"Warning from the Future","dmz.quest.android3.desc":"A mysterious warrior has changed the invasion's outcome. Speak with Trunks and learn what is coming.","dmz.quest.android4.name":"Three Years of Preparation","dmz.quest.android4.desc":"The Androids are still coming. Spend the waiting period training until your body is ready for what Trunks warned about.","dmz.quest.android5.name":"Android 19","dmz.quest.android5.desc":"The first android drains energy from anyone careless enough to fight head-on. Take 19 down fast.","dmz.quest.android6.name":"Dr. Gero","dmz.quest.android6.desc":"The creator of the Androids is on the move. Stop Dr. Gero before he can unleash something worse.","dmz.quest.android7.name":"Track the Androids","dmz.quest.android7.desc":"The real Androids vanished into the mountains after Gero's defeat. Search the range and pick up their trail.","dmz.quest.android8.name":"Android 18","dmz.quest.android8.desc":"Android 18 fights with cold confidence and overwhelming force. Survive her assault before the pair moves on.","dmz.quest.android9.name":"Android 17","dmz.quest.android9.desc":"Android 17 is reckless, cruel, and stronger than expected. Bring him down before he tears through the world.","dmz.quest.android10.name":"Cell Emerges","dmz.quest.android10.desc":"A bio-android from another timeline is feeding on the living. Hunt Imperfect Cell before he reaches the Androids.","dmz.quest.android11.name":"Semi-Perfect Cell","dmz.quest.android11.desc":"Cell has absorbed 17 and evolved into a stronger form. Stand against Semi-Perfect Cell before he reaches 18.","dmz.quest.android12.name":"Beyond Super Saiyan","dmz.quest.android12.desc":"The Cell Games are coming. Push beyond your current limits before Cell proves his perfect power.","dmz.quest.android13.name":"Perfect Cell","dmz.quest.android13.desc":"Cell has achieved perfection and opened the Cell Games. Face him in the arena that decides Earth's fate.","dmz.quest.android14.name":"Cell Juniors","dmz.quest.android14.desc":"Cell's children are tearing through the fighters. Destroy them before the arena collapses.","dmz.quest.android15.name":"Super Perfect Cell","dmz.quest.android15.desc":"Cell has returned stronger after Goku's sacrifice. End the fight for good before he destroys everything left standing.","dmz.saga.future_saga":"Future Saga","dmz.quest.future1.name":"A Future in Ruins","dmz.quest.future1.desc":"Future Trunks asks you to hear what became of his timeline after the Androids won. Speak with him and prepare to step into that nightmare.","dmz.quest.future2.name":"Resistance Training","dmz.quest.future2.desc":"Train on the plains with Future Trunks and Future Gohan. Their world has no room for hesitation.","dmz.quest.future3.name":"Androids of the Future","dmz.quest.future3.desc":"Android 17 and Android 18 are tearing through the ruined plains. Fight them before their destruction spreads any further.","dmz.quest.future4.name":"Future Gohan's Last Stand","dmz.quest.future4.desc":"Future Gohan pushes himself into Super Saiyan for one final battle. Face him and carry his resolve forward.","dmz.quest.future5.name":"Mountain Ambush","dmz.quest.future5.desc":"The Androids have retreated into the mountains. Track them down and end the hunt on their chosen ground.","dmz.quest.future6.name":"Imperfect Cell of the Future","dmz.quest.future6.desc":"A younger Imperfect Cell is stalking the plains, feeding on what remains of the future. Destroy him before he escapes into another timeline.","dmz.quest.future7.name":"Future Restored","dmz.quest.future7.desc":"The future has a chance to heal. Report back to Trunks and close this optional saga.","dmz.saga.buu_saga":"Buu Saga","dmz.quest.buu1.name":"Train with Goten and Gohan","dmz.quest.buu1.desc":"Peace never lasts. Train on the plains with Goten and Gohan before the next threat reveals itself.","dmz.quest.buu2.name":"Gravity Device Components","dmz.quest.buu2.desc":"A full gravity device will need serious machinery. Gather Kikono station parts, a fuel generator, and enough cabling to support the training load.","dmz.quest.buu3.name":"Trunks and Vegeta Training","dmz.quest.buu3.desc":"Train with Trunks and Vegeta under harsher conditions. Vegeta will not accept weak preparation.","dmz.quest.buu4.name":"Enter the World Tournament","dmz.quest.buu4.desc":"The World Martial Arts Tournament is underway. Speak with Piccolo and step into the tournament path.","dmz.quest.buu5.name":"Tournament: Goten","dmz.quest.buu5.desc":"Your first tournament bout is against Goten. Do not underestimate him because of his size.","dmz.quest.buu6.name":"Tournament: Trunks","dmz.quest.buu6.desc":"Kid Trunks enters with a Saiyan's pride and a champion's confidence. Defeat him in the tournament ring.","dmz.quest.buu7.name":"Tournament: Krillin","dmz.quest.buu7.desc":"Krillin brings years of experience into the tournament. Break through his technique and keep advancing.","dmz.quest.buu8.name":"Tournament: Shin","dmz.quest.buu8.desc":"Shin's calm hides a deeper purpose. Face him and learn why he is watching the tournament so closely.","dmz.quest.buu9.name":"Tournament: Spopovich","dmz.quest.buu9.desc":"Spopovich fights with unnatural strength. Defeat him before his stolen energy serves Babidi's plan.","dmz.quest.buu10.name":"Find Babidi's Ship","dmz.quest.buu10.desc":"Shin tracks Babidi's energy to a rocky wasteland. Follow the signal and find the entrance to the wizard's lair.","dmz.quest.buu11.name":"Babidi's Guard: Pui Pui","dmz.quest.buu11.desc":"Pui Pui guards the first level of Babidi's ship. Drop him and keep moving before the seal weakens.","dmz.quest.buu12.name":"Babidi's Guard: Yakon","dmz.quest.buu12.desc":"Yakon feeds on energy and darkness. Keep your power under control and bring the monster down.","dmz.quest.buu13.name":"Dabura, King of Demons","dmz.quest.buu13.desc":"Dabura stands between you and Babidi's plan. Survive his demonic power and cut through the ship's last defense.","dmz.quest.buu14.name":"Majin Buu Awakens","dmz.quest.buu14.desc":"Fat Buu has awakened. The innocent smile hides power that can erase the world.","dmz.quest.buu15.name":"Goku and Vegeta Clash","dmz.quest.buu15.desc":"Goku and Majin Vegeta's battle is feeding the disaster. Survive both warriors and force the battle back toward Buu.","dmz.quest.buu16.name":"Buu's Second Rampage","dmz.quest.buu16.desc":"Fat Buu is still loose and growing harder to contain. Fight him again before the damage becomes permanent.","dmz.quest.buu17.name":"Stop Babidi","dmz.quest.buu17.desc":"Babidi thinks he can control the monster he released. End the wizard's influence before he steers Buu toward more destruction.","dmz.quest.buu18.name":"Super Saiyan 3","dmz.quest.buu18.desc":"Goku reveals a power beyond Super Saiyan 2 on the plains. Stand against Super Saiyan 3 and learn what the next battles demand.","dmz.quest.buu19.name":"Beach Training with Gotenks","dmz.quest.buu19.desc":"Gotenks needs field experience away from the cities. Meet him at the beach and test the fusion's raw power.","dmz.quest.buu20.name":"Evil Buu","dmz.quest.buu20.desc":"Buu's evil has split into its own body. Face Evil Buu before the innocent side is consumed.","dmz.quest.buu21.name":"Krillin and Android 18","dmz.quest.buu21.desc":"Krillin and Android 18 test your readiness for the chaos ahead. Train against them together on the plains.","dmz.quest.buu22.name":"Super Buu in the Time Chamber","dmz.quest.buu22.desc":"Super Buu has reached the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Fight him in that isolated space before he breaks loose.","dmz.quest.buu23.name":"Gotenks at Full Power","dmz.quest.buu23.desc":"Gotenks brings Super Saiyan 3 power to the rocky wasteland. Prove you can survive that pressure before facing Buu again.","dmz.quest.buu24.name":"The Z Sword and Ultimate Power","dmz.quest.buu24.desc":"Travel to the sacred lands, carry the Z Sword, and reach the Potential Unlock level needed to awaken ultimate power.","dmz.quest.buu25.name":"Super Buu Returns","dmz.quest.buu25.desc":"Super Buu has returned stronger and more focused. Challenge him in the rocky wasteland.","dmz.quest.buu26.name":"Super Buu Gotenks","dmz.quest.buu26.desc":"Buu has absorbed Gotenks and stolen his explosive power. Bring down the fused monster before the timer runs out.","dmz.quest.buu27.name":"Super Buu Gohan","dmz.quest.buu27.desc":"Buu has absorbed Gohan and reached a terrifying new peak. Survive the power of Super Buu Gohan.","dmz.quest.buu28.name":"Face Vegetto","dmz.quest.buu28.desc":"Vegetto's combined power is overwhelming. Fight through Goku and Vegeta's fused pressure and prepare for the final rescue.","dmz.quest.buu29.name":"Return to the Sacred World","dmz.quest.buu29.desc":"The final battle moves to the sacred world. Reach the sacred village before Kid Buu arrives.","dmz.quest.buu30.name":"Kid Buu","dmz.quest.buu30.desc":"Kid Buu is pure destruction with no restraint. Fight him on sacred ground and hold him back.","dmz.quest.buu31.name":"Goku's Final Stand","dmz.quest.buu31.desc":"Goku pushes Super Saiyan 3 to its limit. Face him and buy the time needed for one last chance.","dmz.quest.buu32.name":"Vegeta's Final Stand","dmz.quest.buu32.desc":"Vegeta steps in with Super Saiyan 2 resolve. Stand beside his defiance and test yourself against it.","dmz.quest.buu33.name":"Satan and Majin Buu","dmz.quest.buu33.desc":"Majin Buu's friendship with Mr. Satan becomes the world's unlikely hope. Hold the line with Buu while that hope takes shape.","dmz.quest.buu34.name":"Destroy Kid Buu","dmz.quest.buu34.desc":"This is the final clash. Destroy Kid Buu before his chaos reaches Earth again.","dmz.quest.buu35.name":"Return to Earth","dmz.quest.buu35.desc":"The battle is over. Return to Earth and close the Buu Saga.","dmz.saga.movies_saga":"Movies Saga","dmz.quest.movies1.name":"Kami's Lookout Warning","dmz.quest.movies1.desc":"Dende senses Garlic Jr.'s return. Go to Kami's Lookout and speak with him before the threat spreads.","dmz.quest.movies2.name":"Garlic Jr. in the Wasteland","dmz.quest.movies2.desc":"Garlic Jr. has moved into the rocky wastes. Face him before he can open a path to the Dead Zone.","dmz.quest.movies3.name":"Garlic Jr. Transformed","dmz.quest.movies3.desc":"Garlic Jr. draws on his hidden power. Defeat him after his transformation takes hold.","dmz.quest.movies4.name":"Frozen Biome Signal","dmz.quest.movies4.desc":"A strange signal leads into a frozen biome. Investigate the ice before Dr. Wheelo's plan advances.","dmz.quest.movies5.name":"Controlled Allies","dmz.quest.movies5.desc":"Gohan and Krillin are being forced into battle. Break Dr. Wheelo's hold without letting them stop you.","dmz.quest.movies6.name":"Dr. Wheelo","dmz.quest.movies6.desc":"Dr. Wheelo's mechanical body is ready for combat. Destroy him in the frozen wastes.","dmz.quest.movies7.name":"Tree of Might Wasteland","dmz.quest.movies7.desc":"Turles has chosen rocky ground for the Tree of Might. Reach the wasteland and find his trail.","dmz.quest.movies8.name":"Turles' Goku","dmz.quest.movies8.desc":"Goku stands between you and Turles' forces. Test yourself against him before the tree drains the planet.","dmz.quest.movies9.name":"Oozaru Gohan","dmz.quest.movies9.desc":"Gohan has become an Oozaru under Turles' influence. Stop the rampage before it tears through the battlefield.","dmz.quest.movies10.name":"Turles","dmz.quest.movies10.desc":"Turles has taken the fruit of the Tree of Might. Defeat the pirate Saiyan in the rocky wastes.","dmz.quest.movies11.name":"Slug's Soldiers","dmz.quest.movies11.desc":"Lord Slug's soldiers have landed on Earth. Clear them from the plains before their master arrives.","dmz.quest.movies12.name":"Lord Slug","dmz.quest.movies12.desc":"Lord Slug enters the fight himself. Defeat him before he can claim Earth.","dmz.quest.movies13.name":"Giant Lord Slug","dmz.quest.movies13.desc":"Slug reveals his giant Namekian power. Bring down his transformed body in the open plains.","dmz.quest.movies14.name":"Cooler's Armored Squadron","dmz.quest.movies14.desc":"Neiz, Salza, and Dore have arrived ahead of Cooler. Defeat the squadron and force Cooler into the fight.","dmz.quest.movies15.name":"Cooler","dmz.quest.movies15.desc":"Cooler has come to avenge Frieza. Face him in the rocky terrain.","dmz.quest.movies16.name":"Cooler's Fifth Form","dmz.quest.movies16.desc":"Cooler reveals a form beyond Frieza's final power. Defeat him after the transformation.","dmz.quest.movies17.name":"Big Gete Star","dmz.quest.movies17.desc":"Gete machines are spreading across Namek. Destroy them before Metal Cooler multiplies further.","dmz.quest.movies18.name":"Metal Cooler","dmz.quest.movies18.desc":"Metal Cooler attacks on Namek with a machine body. Defeat the copy before the swarm grows.","dmz.quest.movies19.name":"Metal Cooler Core","dmz.quest.movies19.desc":"The core of the Big Gete Star is exposed. Destroy Metal Cooler's source.","dmz.quest.movies20.name":"Androids in the Ice","dmz.quest.movies20.desc":"Android 14 and Android 15 are waiting in the frozen biome. Defeat them before Android 13 absorbs their parts.","dmz.quest.movies21.name":"Android 13","dmz.quest.movies21.desc":"Android 13 enters the battle with cold Red Ribbon intent. Defeat him in the ice.","dmz.quest.movies22.name":"Super Android 13","dmz.quest.movies22.desc":"Android 13 has powered up with the fallen androids' components. Destroy his super form.","dmz.quest.movies23.name":"Broly Base","dmz.quest.movies23.desc":"Broly's restrained power is breaking loose. Fight him before the legend fully awakens.","dmz.quest.movies24.name":"Paragus","dmz.quest.movies24.desc":"Paragus is the hand behind Broly's control. Defeat him and end his scheme.","dmz.quest.movies25.name":"Legendary Broly","dmz.quest.movies25.desc":"Broly's legendary Super Saiyan power is unleashed. Survive the storm and defeat him.","dmz.quest.movies26.name":"Bojack's Allies","dmz.quest.movies26.desc":"Bojack's crew has entered the tournament grounds. Defeat his allies before challenging their leader.","dmz.quest.movies27.name":"Gokua","dmz.quest.movies27.desc":"Gokua steps forward as Bojack's blade. Defeat him in the plains.","dmz.quest.movies28.name":"Bojack","dmz.quest.movies28.desc":"Bojack is free and hunting for conquest. Defeat him before he reaches full power.","dmz.quest.movies29.name":"Full Power Bojack","dmz.quest.movies29.desc":"Bojack reveals his full strength. Put an end to the Galaxy Soldier's attack.","dmz.quest.movies30.name":"Broly's Second Coming","dmz.quest.movies30.desc":"Broly has returned in the frozen lands. Fight the Super Saiyan before his fury spreads.","dmz.quest.movies31.name":"Goten and Trunks","dmz.quest.movies31.desc":"Goten and Trunks rush into the battle. Defeat them in sparring combat before Broly returns.","dmz.quest.movies32.name":"Legendary Broly Returns","dmz.quest.movies32.desc":"Broly's legendary power erupts again. Defeat him in the frozen battlefield.","dmz.quest.movies33.name":"Bio-Broly","dmz.quest.movies33.desc":"Bio-Broly emerges from the swamp. Stop the unstable clone before it mutates further.","dmz.quest.movies34.name":"Giant Bio-Broly","dmz.quest.movies34.desc":"Bio-Broly grows into a massive threat. Bring the giant clone down in the swamp.","dmz.quest.movies35.name":"Otherworld Tournament","dmz.quest.movies35.desc":"The next disturbance starts in Otherworld. Face Pikkon before Janemba's chaos takes over.","dmz.quest.movies36.name":"Janemba","dmz.quest.movies36.desc":"Janemba's first form twists Otherworld itself. Defeat him before reality breaks apart.","dmz.quest.movies37.name":"Super Janemba","dmz.quest.movies37.desc":"Janemba condenses into a faster, deadlier form. Destroy Super Janemba in Otherworld.","dmz.quest.movies38.name":"Hildegarn's Upper Half","dmz.quest.movies38.desc":"Hildegarn's upper half has manifested on Earth. Fight the monster before it becomes whole.","dmz.quest.movies39.name":"Complete Hildegarn","dmz.quest.movies39.desc":"Hildegarn is complete and tearing through the plains. Defeat the full monster.","dmz.quest.movies40.name":"Super Hildegarn","dmz.quest.movies40.desc":"Hildegarn reaches its final power. End the Dragon Fist crisis with one last battle.","dmz.sidequest.roshi_basic.name":"Roshi's Basic Training","dmz.sidequest.roshi_basic.desc":"Master Roshi has agreed to train you, but first you must prove your worth. Find Kame House and show your combat skills.","dmz.sidequest.endurance.name":"Endurance Training","dmz.sidequest.endurance.desc":"Roshi says true warriors must fight all kinds of enemies. Prove your endurance against tougher foes.","dmz.sidequest.weighted.name":"Weighted Training","dmz.sidequest.weighted.desc":"It's time to train with weighted gear. Defeat powerful foes and gather materials for your training equipment.","dmz.sidequest.gravity.name":"Gravity Chamber","dmz.sidequest.gravity.desc":"You've earned access to intense gravity training. Venture into dangerous territory and prove you can handle extreme conditions.","dmz.sidequest.specializedtr.name":"Specialized Training","dmz.sidequest.specializedtr.desc":"Bulma needs some items for her top-secret and very interesting training, bring her what she needs.","dmz.sidequest.explorer.name":"World Explorer","dmz.sidequest.explorer.desc":"A warrior must know the land they protect. Explore the different biomes of the world.","dmz.sidequest.earth_landmarks.name":"Earth Landmarks","dmz.sidequest.earth_landmarks.desc":"Survey Earth's most important martial arts landmarks: Kame House, Goku's House, and Kami's Lookout.","dmz.sidequest.namek_explorer.name":"Namek Explorer","dmz.sidequest.namek_explorer.desc":"You've reached Namek! Explore this alien world and discover the villages of the Namekian people.","dmz.sidequest.sacred_lands.name":"The Sacred Lands","dmz.sidequest.sacred_lands.desc":"The Namekian elders speak of a sacred village hidden on this world. Find it and uncover its secrets.","dmz.sidequest.monster_hunter.name":"Monster Hunter","dmz.sidequest.monster_hunter.desc":"The world is filled with dangerous creatures. Prove yourself as a monster hunter by eliminating various threats.","dmz.sidequest.nether_warrior.name":"Nether Warrior","dmz.sidequest.nether_warrior.desc":"The Nether holds powerful enemies. Only a true warrior can survive its fiery depths.","dmz.sidequest.red_ribbon_outpost.name":"Red Ribbon Outpost","dmz.sidequest.red_ribbon_outpost.desc":"An outpost is stirring up trouble in the countryside. Track it down and clear out the raiders.","dmz.sidequest.krillin_sparring.name":"Krillin's Sparring Match","dmz.sidequest.krillin_sparring.desc":"Krillin wants a sparring partner to prepare for the incoming Saiyan threat. Show him you can hold your own against the local monsters.","dmz.sidequest.tien_mountain.name":"Mountain Training","dmz.sidequest.tien_mountain.desc":"Krillin invites you to train in the harsh mountains. Only by facing powerful foes in extreme terrain can you prepare for the Saiyans.","dmz.sidequest.piccolo_survival.name":"Wilderness Survival","dmz.sidequest.piccolo_survival.desc":"Piccolo believes in training through pure survival. Venture into the forest and prove your combat skills against waves of hostile creatures.","dmz.sidequest.gohan_survival.name":"Gohan's Survival Kit","dmz.sidequest.gohan_survival.desc":"Piccolo left young Gohan alone in the wilderness to toughen him up. The boy could use some supplies & bring him food and a weapon.","dmz.sidequest.vegeta_pride.name":"Vegeta's Pride Training","dmz.sidequest.vegeta_pride.desc":"Vegeta demands you keep up with his training regimen. Enter the Hyperbolic Time Chamber and fight the deadliest enemies to prove you're worthy of a Saiyan's respect.","dmz.sidequest.gohan_timechamber.name":"Gohan's Time Chamber Training","dmz.sidequest.gohan_timechamber.desc":"Gohan is training inside the Hyperbolic Time Chamber to unlock his hidden potential. Help him prepare by gathering supplies and clearing out phantom threats.","dmz.sidequest.kaiosama_buu.name":"Kaiosama's Warning","dmz.sidequest.kaiosama_buu.desc":"King Kai senses a sleeping evil behind the tournament. Speak with him before Babidi's plan reaches Earth.","dmz.sidequest.old_kai_ritual.name":"Old Kai's Ritual","dmz.sidequest.old_kai_ritual.desc":"The Z Sword has revealed a stranger path to hidden power. Bring the sword to the sacred village, speak with King Kai, and complete the ritual to awaken your ultimate potential.","dmz.sidequest.krillin_scout.name":"Namek Reconnaissance","dmz.sidequest.krillin_scout.desc":"Krillin asks you to scout the Ajissa Plains for safe routes through Frieza's territory. Find a Namekian village and report back.","dmz.sidequest.namek_farewell.name":"Namek's Farewell","dmz.sidequest.namek_farewell.desc":"Before Namek's fate is sealed, Guru asks you to visit the Sacred Lands one last time and pay your respects to this dying world.","dmz.sidequest.trunks_warning.name":"Trunks' Warning","dmz.sidequest.trunks_warning.desc":"A mysterious warrior from the future warns you about the Android threat. Investigate Dr. Gero's laboratory to uncover his plans before it's too late.","dmz.sidequest.piccolo_kami.name":"Piccolo's Resolve","dmz.sidequest.piccolo_kami.desc":"Piccolo contemplates fusing with Kami to gain the power needed to fight the Androids. Visit Kami's Lookout and help him find the clarity he needs.","dmz.sidequest.yamcha_bandit.name":"Desert Wolf's Grudge","dmz.sidequest.yamcha_bandit.desc":"Yamcha's old desert hideout has been overrun by bandits. He asks you to clear them out & for old times' sake.","dmz.sidequest.ginyu_warmup.name":"Ginyu Force Warm-Up","dmz.sidequest.ginyu_warmup.desc":"The Ginyu Force is coming. Goku asks you to train by clearing out Frieza's remaining soldiers on the Ajissa Plains & you'll need every ounce of strength.","dmz.sidequest.krillin_patrol.name":"Android Patrol","dmz.sidequest.krillin_patrol.desc":"Krillin asks you to patrol the rocky wastelands for Android sightings. Clear out any Red Ribbon remnants you find along the way.","dmz.sidequest.tien_cell.name":"Hunting Cell","dmz.sidequest.tien_cell.desc":"Krillin senses a dark energy spreading across the plains. Help him investigate by eliminating the creatures Cell has been absorbing from.","dmz.sidequest.videl_defense.name":"City Defense","dmz.sidequest.videl_defense.desc":"Cell Juniors are wreaking havoc everywhere! Gohan asks for your help defending the innocent from these miniature terrors.","dmz.sidequest.piccolo_arrival.name":"Piccolo's Arrival","dmz.sidequest.piccolo_arrival.desc":"Piccolo has finally arrived on Planet Namek. He needs you to create a distraction by drawing out Frieza's soldiers while he powers up.","dmz.sidequest.goku_healing.name":"Defending the Healing Pod","dmz.sidequest.goku_healing.desc":"Goku is recovering in a healing pod after his battle with the Ginyu Force. Frieza's soldiers are closing in & defend the area at all costs!","dmz.sidequest.goku_farewell.name":"Goku's Final Farewell","dmz.sidequest.goku_farewell.desc":"With Cell defeated, Goku has one last wish & visit Kami's Lookout together one more time. This may be the last chance to say goodbye.","dmz.sidequest.future_gohan_cure.name":"Medicine for the Future","dmz.sidequest.future_gohan_cure.desc":"Future Gohan is badly wounded after the Androids' attack. Gather golden apples and a Senzu Bean, then report back to Trunks.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_radar.name":"Radar Upgrade","dmz.sidequest.bulma_radar.desc":"Bulma needs specific materials to improve the Dragon Radar's range. Gather redstone, copper, and gold for her & she'll make it worth your while.","dmz.sidequest.collect_dballs.name":"Summon Shenron","dmz.sidequest.collect_dballs.desc":"Bulma's radar is ready. Find the seven Earth Dragon Balls, bring them together, summon Shenron, and report back.","dmz.sidequest.chichi_provisions.name":"Provisions for Battle","dmz.sidequest.chichi_provisions.desc":"Goku is preparing a feast for the warriors before the final battle against the Saiyans. Help gather enough food to feed everyone.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_namek.name":"Namekian Research","dmz.sidequest.bulma_namek.desc":"Bulma needs Namekian materials to tune a radar for this alien world. Collect Kikono shards and cloth so the search can begin.","dmz.sidequest.merchant_artifacts.name":"Alien Artifacts","dmz.sidequest.merchant_artifacts.desc":"Bulma discovered rare alien materials on Namek. Retrieve Kikono shards and diamonds for her & she promises a legendary weapon in return.","dmz.sidequest.gohan_namek_db.name":"Summon Porunga","dmz.sidequest.gohan_namek_db.desc":"Guru entrusts you with the village's greatest hope. Find the seven Namekian Dragon Balls, summon Porunga, and return safely.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gero.name":"Gero's Blueprints","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gero.desc":"Bulma needs data from Dr. Gero's laboratory to understand the Androids' weaknesses. Search the lab and bring back redstone circuits and Kikono components.","dmz.sidequest.buu_dragon_balls.name":"Dragon Balls for the Final
    Battle","dmz.sidequest.buu_dragon_balls.desc":"Bulma wants the Earth Dragon Balls ready before Buu's threat gets worse. Summon Shenron and return to her with the result.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_radar_amplifier.name":"Signal Amplifier","dmz.sidequest.bulma_radar_amplifier.desc":"Bulma wants to push the Dragon Radar's range further. Bring her amethyst, redstone and gold and she'll add a long-range tier you can cycle to with a right-click.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_radar_fusion.name":"Bi-Dimensional Radar","dmz.sidequest.bulma_radar_fusion.desc":"Hand Bulma an Earth radar and a Namek radar together and she'll fuse them into a single radar that tracks the Dragon Balls of both worlds.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_proximity_hud.name":"Tracker Display","dmz.sidequest.bulma_proximity_hud.desc":"Bulma adds a proximity display to your radar, reading out the distance to the closest Dragon Ball at a glance.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_scouter_calibration.name":"Scouter Calibration","dmz.sidequest.bulma_scouter_calibration.desc":"A raw scouter reads gibberish. Bring Bulma the parts and she'll calibrate its firmware so it can display an enemy's Battle Power — on the HUD and in your quest enemy previews.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_scouter_bioscan.name":"Bio-Scan Module","dmz.sidequest.bulma_scouter_bioscan.desc":"Bulma needs field scans to build a bio-signature database. Defeat Frieza's soldiers, gather the components, and your scouter will start tagging whether a target is a fighter or a hostile.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_scouter_threat_db.name":"Threat Database","dmz.sidequest.bulma_scouter_threat_db.desc":"With enough combat data, Bulma can compile a threat database — your scouter will reveal an enemy's known attacks and abilities in the quest preview instead of '???'.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_otherworld_drive.name":"Otherworld Drive","dmz.sidequest.bulma_otherworld_drive.desc":"Bulma is certain she can retune a space pod's warp coils to punch a hole straight into the Otherworld. Bring her ender pearls, obsidian and redstone blocks and she'll upgrade your pod to make the trip.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gete_discovery.name":"Metal from the Big Star","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gete_discovery.desc":"Bulma is fascinated by the strange Gete metal. Bring her some Gete scrap and she'll start reverse-engineering its secrets — and reward you with refined ingots.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gete_armor.name":"Gete Forge","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gete_armor.desc":"Bulma has cracked a post-netherite alloy. Bring her Gete ingots and Kikono cloth and she'll give you the pattern to craft Gete armor at the Kikono Station.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gete_enhancements.name":"Gete Enhancements","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gete_enhancements.desc":"Bulma's finest work: special Gete-tech enchantments. Gather the materials and she'll hand you an enchanted book with Ki Conductivity, Gravity Forged and Gete Plating.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_capsule_tech.name":"Capsule Tech","dmz.sidequest.bulma_capsule_tech.desc":"Bulma refines the Capsule Corp formula with Gete cores. Bring her ingots and diamonds and she'll teach you to craft premium Gete capsules that grant triple the stat points.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gete_retrofit.name":"Retrofit Kit","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gete_retrofit.desc":"Why start from scratch? Bulma gives you a smithing template to retrofit existing netherite gear straight into Gete armor at a smithing table.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gravity_mk2.name":"Gravity Room Mk.II","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gravity_mk2.desc":"Bulma upgrades the Gravity Device with Capsule Corp dampeners. While inside an active device's field, they ease the strain of training under weights — though the stronger you get, the less the assist matters.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gravity_mk3.name":"Gravity Room Mk.III","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gravity_mk3.desc":"Bulma tunes the Gravity Device dampeners to their limit, cutting far more of the weight strain inside its field and holding up better at high power — but even this fades as your might climbs.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_ki_battery.name":"Ki Accumulator","dmz.sidequest.bulma_ki_battery.desc":"Bulma builds Gete-cored energy cells. Bring the parts and she'll hand you Ki Accumulators that instantly restore a chunk of your ki on use.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_anti_ki_cloak.name":"Cloaking Device","dmz.sidequest.bulma_anti_ki_cloak.desc":"Bulma reverse-engineers Android suppressor tech into a wearable cloak that hides your Battle Power from enemy scouters.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_time_chamber_link.name":"Temporal Comm-Link","dmz.sidequest.bulma_time_chamber_link.desc":"Bulma rigs a dimensional anchor so your space pod can travel straight to the Hyperbolic Time Chamber.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_capsule_development.name":"Capsule Corp R&D","dmz.sidequest.bulma_capsule_development.desc":"Help Bulma prototype a new capsule line — bring her diamonds and redstone.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_rare_mineral_survey.name":"Rare Mineral Survey","dmz.sidequest.bulma_rare_mineral_survey.desc":"Bulma needs rare-material samples for her research. Gather amethyst and copper.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_weapon_analysis.name":"Weapon Blueprints","dmz.sidequest.bulma_weapon_analysis.desc":"Bring Bulma a weapon and components so she can analyze its design.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_flight_stabilizer.name":"Flight Stabilizer","dmz.sidequest.bulma_flight_stabilizer.desc":"Bulma is building a flight-enhancement module. She needs feathers, redstone and gold.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_saiyan_biology_sample.name":"Saiyan Biology","dmz.sidequest.bulma_saiyan_biology_sample.desc":"Bulma wants combat data on a Saiyan. Defeat one and bring her some diamonds for the lab.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_energy_storage_battery.name":"Power Cell Development","dmz.sidequest.bulma_energy_storage_battery.desc":"A high-capacity power cell needs lapis, redstone blocks and diamonds.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_communication_relay.name":"Communication Relay","dmz.sidequest.bulma_communication_relay.desc":"Bulma is building a long-range comm system. Gather redstone, copper and amethyst.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_frieza_armor_study.name":"Alien Armor Study","dmz.sidequest.bulma_frieza_armor_study.desc":"Bulma studies Frieza Force armor. Defeat some soldiers and bring iron.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_frieza_force_intelligence.name":"Enemy Intelligence","dmz.sidequest.bulma_frieza_force_intelligence.desc":"Bulma is compiling an enemy database. Defeat Frieza's soldiers and bring diamonds.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_namekian_tech_integration.name":"Namekian Tech","dmz.sidequest.bulma_namekian_tech_integration.desc":"Bulma wants to integrate Namekian technology. Gather Kikono shards, copper and redstone.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_senzu_bean_substitute.name":"Synthetic Healing","dmz.sidequest.bulma_senzu_bean_substitute.desc":"Bulma researches a synthetic healing agent. Bring golden carrots, glow berries and Kikono cloth.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_ki_energy_collector.name":"Ki Calibration Device","dmz.sidequest.bulma_ki_energy_collector.desc":"Help calibrate Bulma's ki-energy collector with amethyst and lapis.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_android_parts_delivery.name":"Component Salvage","dmz.sidequest.bulma_android_parts_delivery.desc":"Bulma needs salvaged components — redstone, copper and Kikono shards.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_power_suppression_unit.name":"Power Limiter","dmz.sidequest.bulma_power_suppression_unit.desc":"Bulma is prototyping a power limiter. Gather redstone, glass and diamonds.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_android_tech_reverse_engineer.name":"Android Analysis","dmz.sidequest.bulma_android_tech_reverse_engineer.desc":"Bulma reverse-engineers android technology. Bring redstone and Kikono shards.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gravity_chamber_parts.name":"Gravity Components","dmz.sidequest.bulma_gravity_chamber_parts.desc":"Bulma needs heavy-duty components for a gravity simulator: obsidian, redstone blocks and diamonds.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_power_level_detector.name":"Detector Upgrade","dmz.sidequest.bulma_power_level_detector.desc":"Upgrade Bulma's power-level detector with redstone, glass and amethyst.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_time_chamber_diagnostics.name":"Chamber Diagnostics","dmz.sidequest.bulma_time_chamber_diagnostics.desc":"Run diagnostics on the Time Chamber for Bulma — visit it and bring redstone and diamonds.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_buu_energy_analysis.name":"Majin Energy Analysis","dmz.sidequest.bulma_buu_energy_analysis.desc":"Bulma studies Majin energy. Defeat Majin Buu forms and bring lapis blocks.","dmz.sidequest.bulma_emergency_teleport_device.name":"Emergency Recall","dmz.sidequest.bulma_emergency_teleport_device.desc":"Bulma builds an emergency recall system. Gather ender pearls, obsidian and redstone blocks.","dmz.sidequest.reward.gete_enchant_book":"Gete-tech Enchanted Book","dmz.sidequest.dende_lookout_vigil.name":"Vigil at the Lookout","dmz.sidequest.dende_lookout_vigil.desc":"Garlic Jr. has slipped free of the Dead Zone once more. Dende asks you to keep watch over Kami's Lookout and report anything strange before the Spice Boys strike again.","dmz.sidequest.garlic_jr_spice_boys.name":"The Spice Boys","dmz.sidequest.garlic_jr_spice_boys.desc":"Garlic Jr.'s henchmen are scattered across the wastelands, poisoning everything they touch. Mr. Popo asks you to hunt down what remains of the immortal demon's followers.","dmz.sidequest.wheelo_frozen_rescue.name":"The Frozen Lab","dmz.sidequest.wheelo_frozen_rescue.desc":"Dr. Wheelo's bio-mech lab lies buried beneath the snow. Bulma wants you to brave the frozen wastes and recover the salvageable tech and circuitry before it's lost for good.","dmz.sidequest.turles_tree_sapling.name":"Roots of Might","dmz.sidequest.turles_tree_sapling.desc":"Turles planted the Tree of Might to drain the planet dry. Cut down the rogue Saiyan and gather the saplings and fruit it left behind so Piccolo can study how to stop it spreading.","dmz.sidequest.slug_aftermath.name":"Slug's Shadow","dmz.sidequest.slug_aftermath.desc":"Lord Slug's invasion may be over, but his Namekian soldiers still roam the plains. Guru asks you to put an end to the stragglers and bring peace back to the land.","dmz.sidequest.cooler_squadron_mopup.name":"Armored Squadron Mop-Up","dmz.sidequest.cooler_squadron_mopup.desc":"Cooler's Armored Squadron — Salza, Dore and Neiz — won't stop until the planet is theirs. Krillin asks you to hunt down the elite trio's stragglers wherever they're hiding.","dmz.sidequest.big_gete_salvage.name":"Salvage from the Big Gete Star","dmz.sidequest.big_gete_salvage.desc":"The wreckage of the Big Gete Star is crawling with cyclopian guardian robots. Bulma wants you to clear them out and salvage the priceless Gete metal scattered through the hull.","dmz.sidequest.android_cold_parts.name":"Cold Steel","dmz.sidequest.android_cold_parts.desc":"Dr. Gero's cold-weather androids lie dormant in the ice. Bulma needs the cores of Androids 14 and 15 — venture into the frozen tundra, take them apart, and bring back the components.","dmz.sidequest.bojack_tournament_cleanup.name":"Galaxy Soldiers' Last Stand","dmz.sidequest.bojack_tournament_cleanup.desc":"With Bojack defeated, his Galaxy Soldiers — Zangya, Bido, Bujin and Gokua — are still loose at the arena. Gohan asks you to finish what was started and protect the spectators.","dmz.sidequest.otherworld_pikkon_rematch.name":"Otherworld Rematch","dmz.sidequest.otherworld_pikkon_rematch.desc":"The chaos Janemba unleashed has thrown the Otherworld into disorder. King Kai arranges a rematch with Pikkon to settle the score and restore order beyond the grave — head to the Otherworld and prove yourself.","gui.dragonminez.story.sidequests.category.training":"Training","gui.dragonminez.story.sidequests.category.exploration":"Exploration","gui.dragonminez.story.sidequests.category.combat":"Combat","gui.dragonminez.story.sidequests.category.story":"Story","gui.dragonminez.story.sidequests.category.collection":"Collection","gui.dragonminez.story.sidequests.category.tech":"Capsule     package net.bullettrain.xenopixelsmod.client.ui.atlas;
    
    import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
    import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
    import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.AbstractWidget;
    import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Tooltip;
    import net.minecraft.client.gui.narration.NarrationElementOutput;
    import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
    
    import java.util.function.Consumer;
    
    /**
     * A button whose face is one atlas sprite, drawn at that sprite's native size.
     *
     * <p>Pick the shape that is already the size you want rather than asking for a size and letting the
     * art stretch into it. The bundle ships a separate PNG per size for exactly this reason and bakes
     * the border proportions in at generation time, so a stretched face reads as a distorted frame.
     *
     * <p>Hover is a palette swap to the gold cut of the same shape, which is the convention the
     * bundle's integration notes suggest in place of dedicated lit artwork.
     */
    public class AtlasButton extends AbstractWidget {
        private final String sprite;
        private final Consumer<AtlasButton> action;
    
        /** Sizes the button from the sprite - the preferred form. */
        public AtlasButton(int x, int y, Component message, String sprite,
                           Consumer<AtlasButton> action) {
            this(x, y, XenoAtlasSprites.get(sprite).width(), XenoAtlasSprites.get(sprite).height(),
                    message, sprite, action);
        }
    
        /**
         * Explicit-bounds form. The face still blits at its native size and is centred in the bounds;
         * any extra area only widens the click target.
         */
        public AtlasButton(int x, int y, int width, int height, Component message,
                           String sprite, Consumer<AtlasButton> action) {
            super(x, y, width, height, message);
            this.sprite = sprite;
            this.action = action;
        }
    
        /** Native width of the given shape, so callers can lay out a row of buttons. */
        public static int nativeWidth(String sprite) {
            return XenoAtlasSprites.get(sprite).width();
        }
    
        /** Native height of the given shape. */
        public static int nativeHeight(String sprite) {
            return XenoAtlasSprites.get(sprite).height();
        }
    
        @Override
        protected void renderWidget(GuiGraphics graphics, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
            XenoAtlasSprites.Sprite s = XenoAtlasSprites.get(sprite);
            int faceX = getX() + (getWidth() - s.width()) / 2;
            int faceY = getY() + (getHeight() - s.height()) / 2;
    
            boolean lit = isHoveredOrFocused() && active;
            if (lit) {
                XenoAtlasSprites.blit(graphics, sprite, XenoAtlasSprites.Theme.GOLD, faceX, faceY);
            } else {
                XenoAtlasSprites.blit(graphics, sprite, faceX, faceY);
            }
    
            var font = Minecraft.getInstance().font;
            String label = getMessage().getString();
            int available = Math.max(4, s.width() - 8);
            if (font.width(label) > available) {
                int ellipsis = font.width("...");
                label = font.plainSubstrByWidth(label, Math.max(1, available - ellipsis)) + "...";
                if (getTooltip() == null) {
                    setTooltip(Tooltip.create(getMessage()));
                }
            }
    
            int color = !active ? 0xFF7A8A96 : lit ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFE0F0FF;
            graphics.drawCenteredString(font, label,
                    getX() + getWidth() / 2, getY() + (getHeight() - 8) / 2, color);
        }
    
    
        /**
         * Silences vanilla's click.
         *
         * <p>{@code AbstractWidget.mouseClicked} plays {@code UI_BUTTON_CLICK} before {@code onClick}
         * runs, so without this every control would click twice - vanilla's, then DragonMineZ's. The
         * DMZ sound is played from {@code onClick} instead, via {@link AtlasSound}.
         */
        @Override
        public void playDownSound(net.minecraft.client.sounds.SoundManager handler) {
        }
    
        @Override
        protected void updateWidgetNarration(NarrationElementOutput output) {
            defaultButtonNarrationText(output);
        }
    
        @Override
        public void onClick(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
            AtlasSound.click();
            if (action != null) {
                action.accept(this);
            }
        }
    }
         */
        /**
         * The ordered attack-animation slots.
         *
         * <p>{@code NpcCombatProfile} has carried these since melee animations existed and
         * {@link net.bullettrain.xenopixelsmod.compat.npc.NpcMeleeAnimCycle} walks them in order on
         * consecutive hits, skipping blanks - but nothing ever exposed them, so the only way to fill a
         * slot was a script. A working ordered-attack system with no way to author it is the same
         * dead-weight shape as a stored field nothing reads, just from the other side.
         *
         * <p>Rows are numbered from 1 and laid out in cycle order, because the order <em>is</em> the
         * feature: slot 1 plays, then 2, then 3. The pager handles the rest -
         * {@code MELEE_SLOT_COUNT} slots is more than one page by design.
         */
        private List<EditorRow> attackSlotRows() {
            List<EditorRow> rows = new ArrayList<>();
            rows.add(new EditorRow.Heading("Attack order"));
            rows.add(new EditorRow.Text("", "Played in this order on consecutive hits. Blank slots are",
                    MUTED));
            rows.add(new EditorRow.Text("", "skipped, so gaps are fine.", MUTED));
    
            for (int i = 0; i < NpcCombatProfile.MELEE_SLOT_COUNT; i++) {
                final int slot = i;
                rows.add(field(String.valueOf(slot + 1), profile.meleeSlotClip(slot), 128,
                        v -> profile.setMeleeSlotClip(slot, v), "MeleeAnimSlots"));
                rows.add(toggle("On", profile.meleeSlotOn(slot),
                        v -> profile.setMeleeSlotOn(slot, v), "MeleeAnimSlots"));
            }
            return rows;
        }
